--- ## Walkthrough The AWS backdated boot image test now maps the cluster’s current region to a predefined AMI and fails when the region is unsupported. Behavior for other platforms remains unchanged. ### Changes **AWS boot image selection** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Region-aware AMI lookup**
`test/extended-priv/mco_bootimages.go`|The AWS path derives the current region, retrieves its mapped backdated AMI, and fails the test when no mapping exists.| **Estimated code review effort:** 2 (Simple) | ~10 minutes **Possibly related PRs** - [openshift/machine-config-operator#6324](https://github.com/openshift/machine-config-operator/pull/6324): Both changes modify AWS boot-image handling in MCO tests. **Suggested reviewers:** `proietfb`, `ptalgulk01`

no new Ginkgo tests were added, and the suite already has platform labels/gates. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Only helper AMI selection changed; no new Ginkgo tests or SNO-sensitive assertions/guards were added. | | Topology-Aware Scheduling Compatibility | ✅ Passed | Change only updates AWS backdated AMI lookup in a test helper; no scheduling, affinity, selector, replica, or topology logic was introduced. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The AWS change only adds a region→AMI lookup and gomega check; no new stdout writes appear in main/init/suite setup code. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | No new Ginkgo test bodies were added; the change only selects a region-specific AWS AMI and introduces no IPv4 or public-internet dependency. | | No-Weak-Crypto | ✅ Passed | Only changed code adds an AWS region→AMI map and a gomega expectation;
